New on The Cupcake Index: Stats > Visualize 📊

Build your own chart from any NFL or college stat. Any team, any player, any weeks, any season (NFL back to 2022, college to 2024). Bar, line, pie, scatter or radar, with EPA built in.

Bring receipts to the argument. 🧵

2/ Scatter any two stats against each other. Team logos are the dots, the dashed lines are the averages.

Our Schedules chart lives here now too: SEC schedule strength vs cupcake score. Georgia, all alone at the bottom. Swap either axis for any stat you want.

3/ Compare by role, not just position. Pick WR1, WR2, RB1, TE1 and line up every team's guy side by side.

Roles come from who actually got the targets and carries in the weeks you pick, so it works for any week or season.

The best WR2 in football right now: Puka Nacua.

4/ Pick a team and see how it splits the work. Hover any slice for its share.

Washington's targets: Stefon Diggs 24%, Terry McLaurin 17%, and nobody else above 15%. Is that enough for Jayden Daniels?

5/ Radar charts for player profiles. Every stat is a percentile against QBs with a real workload, so 100 = best in the league.

Purdy vs Allen vs Mahomes vs Lamar. Who's got the best shape?

6/ Set your own minimum dropbacks, carries or targets, and leave out games a QB left by halftime so one injury doesn't sink his numbers.

Every downloaded chart lists its filters in fine print. Nobody gets to say you cherry-picked.

7/ Also new: every college top-25 team page has a Takes tab with conversation starters. Where they rank in the top 25, best win, toughest game left, chance to go unbeaten.

Updated every week. Find all of it under Stats > Visualize and Takes on the site.
